# API / desktop

8 routes in the `desktop` family. `Inventory` says whether the route is also listed in the API command catalog; `Registered in` is the file that mounts it.

Base URL: `http://localhost:8080` — see
[Network Contract](../../02-architecture-packages/network-contract.md).

| Method | Path | Summary | Inventory | Registered in |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/desktop/activity` | schema not modeled | no | `botserver/src/main_module/routes/api_setup.rs` |
| POST | `/api/desktop/connect` | Register a remote desktop connection (VNC or RDP, credentials vaulted) | yes | `botserver/src/core/bot/api_catalog/commands_list.rs` |
| GET | `/api/desktop/connections` | List active and saved remote desktop (VNC/RDP) connections for the user | yes | `botserver/src/core/bot/api_catalog/commands_list.rs` |
| DELETE | `/api/desktop/connections/:param` | Delete a desktop connection and terminate its session | yes | `botserver/src/core/bot/api_catalog/commands_list.rs` |
| GET | `/api/desktop/connections/:param` | Get a single desktop connection by id | yes | `botserver/src/core/bot/api_catalog/commands_list.rs` |
| POST | `/api/desktop/connections/kill` | Terminate all active desktop sessions for the current user | yes | `botserver/src/core/bot/api_catalog/commands_list.rs` |
| POST | `/api/desktop/health/rdp` | Probe an RDP endpoint (host, port) and confirm an RDP server is listening | yes | `botserver/src/core/bot/api_catalog/commands_list.rs` |
| POST | `/api/desktop/health/tcp` | Probe TCP reachability of a host and port | yes | `botserver/src/core/bot/api_catalog/commands_list.rs` |
